_comment: Copy to jarvis/bridge/config.json (git-ignored) and fill in email + password: a Jarvis member's login (best: its own — add it with jarvis_add_member). The Supabase URL and public key are read from jarvis/config.js. Only needed when the Mac side is switched on (JARVIS_CONFIG.MAC). 'scripts' are the ONLY extra commands Jarvis can run on this Mac — each 'run' is a list (program + arguments) run from the repo folder; 'background': true starts it and returns at once (for apps that keep running).
